why: issue 1942 — the width of `RequestId::writer_guid` (16, upstream's `rmw_request_id_t::writer_guid`), named so a caller sizing a buffer for it need not write the literal. rclrs spells the type `[u8; 16]` and names no constant. Deliberately distinct from `PUBLISHER_GID_SIZE` (24, `RMW_GID_STORAGE_SIZE`): upstream keeps the two widths apart.
